accounting.cost_status: Standard short-context API-equivalent estimate; not observed billing, credits, or subscription usage. Base cache-write scenario and doubled write-rate sensitivity.
accounting.token_semantics: Input includes cache reads/writes; uncached=input-cached-write. Output includes reasoning; reasoning is a subset, never added twice. Global response IDs deduplicated.
accounting.elapsed_semantics: Sum is aggregate request duration, wall is earliest request start to latest observed request end. Inflight durations are incomplete.
accounting.tool_usage: Observed tool calls: 0; 0 calls have unknown tool observation coverage. Counts use raw saved observations or an audit bound to the exact raw file SHA256 and fingerprint; unknown is not an observed zero. Provider-reported tool/search usage and billing remain unavailable.
accounting.usage_coverage_note: 0 call artifacts have no response usage. Token/cost sums cover observed response records only; missing accounting is not an observed zero.

quality.winner_reason: Same-family model references/adjudication are provisional; agreement is not truth and does not support a confident winner.

limitations: Source-only model references are not independent historical truth.
No strict per-request 25k reasoning-token ceiling is available.
Four inflight calls may overshoot between-call budget guards.
Quote presence and decision agreement do not establish claim support.

mechanical_validation.rule: Original compare.mechanical(review=True) applied to each immutable final-review prompt.case evidence; no new model calls. Category counts may overlap. Format/quotation failures do not relabel source-based historical judgments.
mechanical_validation.source: Raw call SHA256 hashes listed in input_hashes.raw_calls; original context and prompts remain private.
